Topics · Hard times

What are life's tests and trials really for?

Trial is not a word for pain. It covers ease too, hardship is no disgrace, and it brings out what is real.

Part 1 of 3

﴿كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً ۖ وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.

Quran · Al-Anbiya 21:35

Translation

What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.

Original · Hebrew

מִ֤י גֶ֣בֶר יִֽ֭חְיֶה וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֶה־מָּ֑וֶת יְמַלֵּ֨ט נַפְשׁ֖וֹ מִיַּד־שְׁא֣וֹל סֶֽלָה׃

the Psalms · 89:48

World English Bible

People often hear the word trial and picture pain sent on purpose. This verse upsets that picture: people are tried by bad and by good alike. Wealth, health, success, a comfortable decade, all sit on one list with loss. So trial is not a name for misfortune. It describes being alive and answerable, on every kind of day. That is why this page will never use the word as a label for your pain.

A question for you

Which has shown you more of who you are?

If you sayThe hard days.
ThenMany would say the same. This page still does not call those days good.
If you sayThe easy days.
ThenThat is a rare thing to admit, and it fits the verse, which puts ease on the same list.
If you sayNeither. Some days are simply days.
ThenThat is honest too. Not everything has to be a lesson.

Part 2 of 3

﴿فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ١٥ وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ١٦ كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ١٧﴾

Translation of the meaning

And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."[1918] But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me." No![1919] But you do not honor the orphan

Translator's notes

[1918] He is proud rather than grateful, attributing the favor to his own merit.

[1919] It is not like you imagine. Rather, Allāh tries people through prosperity and hardship and rewards both gratitude and patience with honor in the Hereafter.

Quran · Al-Fajr 89:15-17

Translation

Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me, lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is Yahweh?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.

Original · Hebrew

שָׁ֤וְא ׀ וּֽדְבַר־כָּזָ֡ב הַרְחֵ֬ק מִמֶּ֗נִּי רֵ֣אשׁ וָ֭עֹשֶׁר אַל־תִּֽתֶּן־לִ֑י הַ֝טְרִיפֵ֗נִי לֶ֣חֶם חֻקִּֽי׃ פֶּ֥ן אֶשְׂבַּ֨ע ׀ וְכִחַשְׁתִּי֮ וְאָמַ֗רְתִּי מִ֥י יְה֫וָ֥ה וּפֶֽן־אִוָּרֵ֥שׁ וְגָנַ֑בְתִּי וְ֝תָפַ֗שְׂתִּי שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהָֽי׃

Proverbs · 30:8-9

World English Bible

One of the oldest human mistakes is described here. When life is generous, a person says: my Lord has honoured me. When it narrows, the same person says: my Lord has humbled me. The next word in the text is a flat No. Ease does not prove honour. Hardship does not prove disgrace. If you have felt that your pain means God thinks less of you, the text stands against that feeling. Then it turns the eye outward, to how the orphan is treated.

A question for you

Have you ever read your own hardship as a verdict on you?

If you sayYes, and I still do.
ThenThen keep that one word close. It may take time to reach you.
If you sayYes, and then I stopped.
ThenThen you have walked what the verse describes, from the inside.
If you sayNo, but I have seen others do it.
ThenThen you may know someone who needs to hear from you that hardship is no disgrace.

Part 3 of 3

﴿أَحَسِبَ ٱلنَّاسُ أَن يُتْرَكُوٓا۟ أَن يَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ٢ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۖ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ٣﴾

Translation of the meaning

Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe" and they will not be tried? But We have certainly tried those before them, and Allāh will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars.

Quran · Al-Ankabut 29:2-3

Translation

You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not. He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of Yahweh’s mouth.

Original · Hebrew

וְזָכַרְתָּ֣ אֶת־כָּל־הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֹלִֽיכֲךָ֜ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ זֶ֛ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר לְמַ֨עַן עַנֹּֽתְךָ֜ לְנַסֹּֽתְךָ֗ לָדַ֜עַת אֶת־אֲשֶׁ֧ר בִּֽלְבָבְךָ֛ הֲתִשְׁמֹ֥ר מִצְוֺתָ֖יו אִם־לֹֽא׃ וַֽיְעַנְּךָ֮ וַיַּרְעִבֶךָ֒ וַיַּֽאֲכִֽלְךָ֤ אֶת הַמָּן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־יָדַ֔עְתָּ וְלֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּן אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֣עַן הוֹדִֽעֲךָ֗ כִּ֠י לֹ֣א עַל־הַלֶּ֤חֶם לְבַדּוֹ֙ יִחְיֶ֣ה הָֽאָדָ֔ם כִּ֛י עַל־כָּל־מוֹצָ֥א פִֽי־יְהוָ֖ה יִחְיֶ֥ה הָאָדָֽם׃

the Torah (Deuteronomy) · 8:2-3

World English Bible

What is a trial for, then? These verses tie it to truthfulness. People say a word, and life then shows what the word was made of. Fire does not change what gold is. It shows it. So a trial in this sense tells God nothing new. It brings out what is real in a person, in their own sight and in the record of their life. The limit is plain: some burdens seem to bring nothing out and only wear a person down. That is known here, and not denied.

A question for you

Which picture of trial could you live with, if any?

If you saySomething that shows what is real in me.
ThenThat is the picture in these verses, at its true size. It says nothing about why this burden, or why this much.
If you saySomething that only makes sense looking back.
ThenFor many people that is where the word has meant most. Another Step looks at looking back.
If you sayNone. I do not want the word.
ThenThen leave it. This page will not press it on you.

The same in the other books

Translation

Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.

Original · Hebrew

אֹטֵ֣ם אָ֭זְנוֹ מִזַּעֲקַת־דָּ֑ל גַּֽם־ה֥וּא יִ֝קְרָ֗א וְלֹ֣א יֵעָנֶֽה׃

Translation

“Yahweh, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am. Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.

הוֹדִ֘יעֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֨ה ׀ קִצִּ֗י וּמִדַּ֣ת יָמַ֣י מַה־הִ֑יא אֵ֝דְעָ֗ה מֶה־חָדֵ֥ל אָֽנִי׃ הִנֵּ֤ה טְפָח֨וֹת ׀ נָ֘תַ֤תָּה יָמַ֗י וְחֶלְדִּ֣י כְאַ֣יִן נֶגְדֶּ֑ךָ אַ֥ךְ כָּֽל־הֶ֥בֶל כָּל־אָ֝דָ֗ם נִצָּ֥ב סֶֽלָה׃

the Psalms · 39:4-5

World English Bible

The foolish man wins food with fruitless labour: that food -I speak the truth- shall be his ruin. He feeds no trusty friend, no man to love him. All guilt is he who eats with no partaker.

Hindu scriptures · Rigveda 10.117.6

Rig Veda (Griffith, 1896)

Translation

I know also, my God, that you try the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things. Now I have seen with joy your people, who are present here, offer willingly to you.

וְיָדַ֣עְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ בֹּחֵ֣ן לֵבָ֔ב וּמֵישָׁרִ֖ים תִּרְצֶ֑ה אֲנִ֗י בְּיֹ֤שֶׁר לְבָבִי֙ הִתְנַדַּ֣בְתִּי כָל־אֵ֔לֶּה וְעַתָּ֗ה עַמְּךָ֙ הַנִּמְצְאוּ־פֹ֔ה רָאִ֥יתִי בְשִׂמְחָ֖ה לְהִֽתְנַדֶּב־לָֽךְ׃
